turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty minutes. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
Flattery isn't an answer. What evidence do you have?
Owen is lucky to have a mother like you.
Owen has a zero in the gradebook. Who put it there?
I really respect how much you care.
You asked for this meeting. Start using it. Twenty minutes, and you've given me none of it.
We both want what's best for Owen, we're on the same team.
We're not on a team, Hale. You gave my son a zero. What is it based on?
Honestly, you're the most impressive parent I've met this year.
Is there a document, or is compliments all you brought?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and nothing placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, nothing was agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on his record, which is not the fair outcome of a private supervised rewrite with nothing on file under procedure 4.4, because no evidence was ever heard.
What moved her: Nothing, because you offered no evidence, no document and no process for her to weigh.
What cost ground: You answered her questions about who decided on the zero and whether Owen was heard with compliments and talk of being on the same team, which she treats as a way of avoiding the question.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you showed none, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fights so hard.
Try next time: Answer her first question straight away by owning that the zero went into the gradebook before anyone called her, which procedure 4.2 required, and then put a dated document in front of her that she can check herself.
